svg.desc: Chart(choropleth, 39 features, 1200x780, theme=light, 3224 geographic points, point_labels=none, point_sizes=area, max_radius=7, projection=lambert_azimuthal_equal_area, extent=[-124.90000000000001,45.399999999999999,-116.8,49.100000000000001], center=[-120.84999999999999,47.25]). Longitude; Latitude. AFDC inventory: 28 Oct 2026. Boundaries: U.S. Census 2025, shoreline-clipped cartographic display. Circle area = listed L2 + DC ports; inventory is not interchangeable capacity or measured use. County fill is context only.. Map source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2025 Cartographic Boundary Files; Public-domain U.S. government data; generalized by Aner.. Projection: lambert_azimuthal_equal_area (spherical drawing projection; not a metric CRS). WGS84 extent: west=-124.90000000000001, south=45.399999999999999, east=-116.8, north=49.100000000000001. Projection center: longitude=-120.84999999999999, latitude=47.25. 39 visible of 39 features; colors use the original data range. No basemap or boundary inference.. 3224 visible of 3224 geographic points. Points use an independent color scale over all point values, including points outside the extent. Circle area is proportional to nonnegative size value; radius = maximum radius times sqrt(value / maximum value), over all points including points outside the extent. Zero size values have radius 0. Visible point labels are hidden; full labels and values remain in point tooltips.
